metadata.description: Runs long Claude Code jobs overnight within your usage limits: pauses just before the 5-hour or weekly limit, resumes the same session after the reset (or relaunches it days later) and works through a TASKS.md queue. Also runs in Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, Droid and Copilot CLI.
